deny.reason: its advertising clause conflicts with GPL-3.0 (ADR 0010, ADR 0021)
SlipStream ships under GPL-3.0, not AGPL-3.0 (ADR 0010, ADR 0021)
GPL-2.0-only cannot combine with GPL-3.0 (ADR 0010, ADR 0021)
code with no license grants no right to redistribute it (ADR 0010, ADR 0021)

overrides.name: modernc.org/libc
overrides.reason: LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause; LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.md holds the BSD-3-Clause Go and MIT musl, go-netdb and nixpkgs notices for code inside it, which NOTICES.txt reproduces

overrides.name: modernc.org/memory
overrides.reason: LICENSE, LICENSE-GO and LICENSE-MMAP-GO are BSD-3-Clause; LICENSE-LOGO is only the source URL of the project logo, which the binary does not carry

overrides.name: modernc.org/sqlite
overrides.reason: LICENSE is BSD-3-Clause; LICENSE-SQLITE is SQLite's public-domain dedication, LICENSE-SQLITE_VEC covers the vec package SlipStream does not import, and LICENSE-3RD-PARTY.md lists the module's dependencies, each checked on its own
